question.problem:
$$
\{\begin{aligned}{x}^{′}(t)=-8x(t) \\ {y}^{′}(t)=-8y(t)\end{aligned}
$$

Sketch the phase portrait of the linear system above.
question.worked_solution:
Writing our system in matrix form, we have
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14124655/assets/737c96109e65d59f4df2c2fa574737fe604483fe4ccc9772a3d2bf22ee32e55a.svg)
where ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14124655/assets/22dbda7d3b169206071e5af49fd1fe1af28d86ef1e0a8b37d58eacb62b44c1d2.svg)

Since our system is decoupled, its eigenvalues are $\lambda_1=\lambda_2=-8$ with the corresponding eigenvectors $[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0\end{aligned}]$ and ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14124655/assets/5bd691bbaa9542184d90e55aeb16f4dfcd3d22d092b4652e8bddba7bf0b926aa.svg)

The general solution of the system is
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14124655/assets/8b25789fb45234e4299e4b5ce3371c1afafc181c64f9802d212ae7cbefc0970f.svg)

Notice that for each vector ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14124655/assets/674212f0d815e0588faaf276bd797e9822ac5659e5d4b15a7635d7f1327d5dc5.svg) we get the straight-line solutions of the form
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14124655/assets/d4c31285e6f31a229bc6fc5cbe2d78e2bf50f73bb6305d91687c5dcc31c3885a.svg)
that represent the line passing through the origin and parallel to the vector ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14124655/assets/268764bbe776b03647daac7fc77e8ed24107e1bb0cf16d955f7a845a12c65755.svg)

Since $e^{-8t} \to 0$ as $t \to \infty,$ these solutions approach the origin as $t \to \infty,$ so the origin is a stable node.

The phase portrait satisfying these conditions is the following:

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14124655/assets/4c337f7f6b80f340859844e8217525db98230660d22e760c70218f0c282d21e9.png)
